artworks.title: Discours sur l'égalité des conditions: Il retourne chez ses égaux
artworks.description: This image shows two individuals, one facing away and the other facing towards them. The person on the right has short hair and wears simple clothing, while the person on the left wears a coat, hat, and boots, and holds a cane. Surrounding them are objects indicating a port setting, such as clothing and ships in the water. The sky has clouds and birds, with more ships visible on the horizon.

artworks.title: L'amant de lui-mesme
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Blaise Simonet after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: The image shows two men in an elaborately decorated room. One man is seated on the right, visible from head to knees, on a cushioned chair. He has an oval face with detailed features and wears a decorative robe with ruffles. He holds a small object in one hand and rests the other hand on a table covered with a patterned cloth. The man standing to his left is dressed in a detailed coat, knee breeches, and stockings. The room has intricate wainscoting and decorative wall panels. Above the seated man, there is a wall ornament, possibly a mirror or clock. Nearby, another piece of furniture is draped with fabric.

artworks.title: La découverte du nouveau monde
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple figures in a historic setting. The figures are dressed in elaborate costumes, some wearing feathered headdresses and others in hats typically worn by European colonists. They are inside a structure with exposed beams and thatched roofing. The background includes a palm tree and an open view to an outdoor space. The detailed line work captures the textures of the costumes and architectural elements with precision.

artworks.title: Iphis
artworks.description: The image shows two central figures surrounded by multiple individuals. The figure on the left is in an assertive stance, wearing a helmet, classical armor, and a draped garment. The figure on the right has shoulder-length hair and is dressed in a tunic with a decorative border and a cloak, raising one hand. They both hold shields, one of which is prominently decorated. Soldiers stand around them, some holding spears and helmets. Banners and standards are visible in the background, with a cloudy sky overhead.

artworks.title: Ah! Jeune homme à ton bienfaiteur
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dimly lit interior scene with two figures interacting. One figure is seated at a table, looking surprised, while the other figure is standing and leaning forward towards them with one arm extended. The table holds a pair of candlesticks, casting shadows in the room. The seated figure is draped in robes and positioned to the left, with a curtain in the background. The standing figure on the right is dressed in cloaked attire reminiscent of 18th-century fashion. The room is richly furnished with a curtain, chair, and wooden table.

artworks.title: Julie s'évanouit dans un fauteuil
artworks.artist: Noël Le Mire after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: The image is a black and white etching showing four people gathered around a person who is fainting in a chair. The fainting person is seated in an ornate chair with their upper body leaning backward, head tilted back, and an arm hanging over the armrest. They have delicate facial features and a voluminous, curled hairstyle, dressed in elaborate clothing like a gown with frills and lace. Three others - two women and one man - are close by, also wearing period clothing with frilled fabrics, elaborate updo hairstyles. One man is supporting the fainting person's head. A window with drawn curtains is on the left, and the wall has paneling with a framed portrait. Some furniture is visible, emphasizing the ornate setting.

artworks.title: Elle s'élance après lui
artworks.description: Several people are depicted on a riverbank, leaning forward with their arms raised. Most of the figures are women in elaborate period clothing, including flowing dresses. The man is wearing a tricorn hat. Their facial expressions appear surprised or alarmed, and their hairstyles are typical of the 18th century. The main woman wears a dress with lace and ribbons, a hat with plumes, and holds a handkerchief. The scene conveys a sense of movement, with a background of trees, buildings, and people near the shore, possibly reacting to a woman in the water holding her hat.

artworks.title: Il appliqua sur cette main un baiser que je sentis sur mon coeur
artworks.description: The image depicts two women standing side-by-side, facing each other. The woman on the left is holding a sheet of paper. The woman on the right is facing front, with her head slightly tilted towards her companion. Both women have elaborate hairstyles and wear opulent 18th-century gowns. A man is leaning on a piano or harpsichord, with his head resting on his hand. The room features a curtained backdrop and a panelled wall, with a music stand and a cello.

artworks.title: Sans rien comprendre à ce mystere
artworks.artist: Noël Le Mire after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in a garden setting. They are positioned close together, with one man on the left leaning in towards a woman in the center, while another woman stands to the right holding the central woman's arm. The central woman has a delicate facial expression and both women's hair is styled up. The man has his hair styled back and wears formal attire with a coat and breeches. The women are dressed in elaborate gowns, featuring layers and detailed fabric designs. The background reveals lush garden foliage, a stone balustrade, and a decorative column.

artworks.title: Frontispiece: Dictionnaire de musique
artworks.description: This drawing features an allegorical figure playing a lyre next to a globe, with a temple in the distance. The central figure is seated in a natural setting, holding a lyre, surrounded by symbols, including a globe and a carved column pedestal with a putto and animals. In the background, there are smaller figures playing musical instruments beneath a large tree. A classical temple can be seen atop a hill in the distance. The drawing uses shading and fine lines to create depth and detail, conveying a sense of symbolism and harmony.

artworks.title: Pygmalion
artworks.artist: Noël Le Mire after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene involving a kneeling figure gesturing towards a partially draped, nude standing figure. The drawing depicts an interaction between these two figures, set within an architecturally grand interior with ornate drapery and columns in the background. The foreground figure stands on a pedestal. Surrounding these figures are sculpting tools and a partially sculpted figure. The detailed shading and use of line contribute to the composition.

artworks.title: J'ai tort, mon cher Valère, et t'en demande excuse
artworks.artist: Jean Jacques Le Veau after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: The image features three figures within a columned architectural setting. On the left, a woman stands with her body slightly turned, gesturing towards the two men. She has a delicate facial structure, styled hair, and wears an elaborate headpiece, an extravagant dress with a ruffled skirt and detailed bodice. The man in the center has raised arms, a somber face, a small hat under his arm, long hair, knee-length trousers, stockings, and a coat. The man on the right leans forward, arms extended towards the center figure, wearing a tricorn hat, knee-length trousers, and a coat. In the background, large columns and detailed moldings create an ornate architectural setting.

artworks.title: Saint-Preux sort de chez des femmes du monde
artworks.description: The image shows a group of eight people moving down a staircase. One person is at the front, wearing a tricorn hat and knee-length coat, appearing to be in motion down the stairs, while the others follow closely behind, some extending their arms toward him. The facial expressions of the group indicate interest and engagement. The individuals are dressed in historical attire typical of the 18th century, with women wearing dresses and men in coats and breeches. The background features an interior with a doorway visible at the top of the staircase, casting shadows. There is a wrought iron railing on the staircase.

artworks.title: L'inoculation de l'amour
artworks.artist: Noël Le Mire after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures in a room: two women and one man. The man is partially seated on the bed, leaning forward towards one of the women who is partially reclined on the bed. He is dressed in elaborate 18th-century attire. The woman whose hand he is kissing wears an ornate gown, and the third figure, another woman, stands by the bed with one hand placed on the seated woman's arm. The room is elegantly furnished with heavy curtains, a decorative chair, and a table with glass bottles. The background features intricately paneled walls.

artworks.title: La Provocation
artworks.description: Three men are depicted in an elegantly furnished room. The first man stands on the left, leaning back with his eyes closed or cast downward. He is dressed in traditional 18th-century attire. The second man is seated in the middle, reaching upwards with his left hand. The third man stands on the right, gesturing towards the man on the left. The room features armchairs, a round table with decorative items, and heavy drapes on the walls. The image is framed with a subtle embossment on the paper.

artworks.title: Le Soufflet
artworks.artist: Noël Le Mire after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: The image shows three people engaged in a dynamic interaction. The person on the left is in a leaning posture with one leg lifted and holding a fan. They have curly hair and wear period attire. The person in the center is leaning towards the third individual while looking upwards, wearing an ornate dress with lace and ruffles. The third person on the right has their arms raised and wears a flowing dress, with a decorative hairstyle. The setting includes elegant interior details like panelled walls, a decorative fireplace, and a door with intricate detailing. A chair and table with items on it are visible, along with fabric near the left chair.

artworks.title: Mort de Julie
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene around a four-poster bed. The interior room includes a canopied bed with curtains partially open. There are ornate chairs nearby. A figure is in bed, looking distressed. Other figures interact around the bed, with one reaching out towards it. The setting is elegant with classical elements such as panels or portraits on the walls and detailed drapery on the bed. The drawing conveys a sense of urgency or drama within a domestic, possibly historical or narrative context.

artworks.title: Saint Roch and Saint Sebastian
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length figures in front of an ornately decorated architectural setting. The figure on the left is a bearded man with curly hair, wearing a draped garment and sandals. The person on the right has long wavy hair and wears a robe, holding an object resembling a spear. Both figures have circular halos above their heads. The background features an archway supported by a column with carvings, with a countryside scene visible beyond. The interior setting is patterned with designs on the floor and walls.

artworks.title: James Nares
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man's upper body, including his head and shoulders. The man is facing slightly to his left with a composed expression. His facial features include prominent cheekbones, a straight nose, and a slight smile. He has formal 18th-century styled hair with curled sides and a voluminous top. He is dressed in a dark coat over a lighter waistcoat and a white neckcloth. The background features an oval frame of foliage and a plain background with some speckled patterns.

artworks.title: Whistler
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on blue paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a pose, one hand on his hip and the other holding a walking stick. He has distinct facial features, a mustache, and wears a monocle on his right eye. His hair is curly, dark, and under a wide-brimmed hat. He wears a long, double-breasted, tan coat with a high collar, dark trousers, and shoes. A white shirt is visible under the coat. The background is a simple, flat pale color.

artworks.title: En Plein Soleil
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated outdoors, holding an open umbrella. She has a casual posture, with one hand on her knee. Her face has a serene expression, and she has dark hair, possibly short or tied up. She wears a long striped garment. Nearby, there is a small object on the grass. The background includes sketch-like grass and distant buildings or rooftops.

artworks.title: Gretchen at Heidelberg
artworks.medium: etching in dark brown on green/grey laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a seated woman. She is positioned with her body facing slightly toward the left. Her right hand rests on her cheek, and her left arm is stretched across her body, holding a palette with brushes. She has a contemplative expression with smooth, youthful features, and her hair is pulled back. She is dressed in a long-sleeved gown with a full apron, and a bow fastened at her neckline. There are no visible pieces of jewelry. The background shows an interior with a window behind her on the left side and books stacked on a shelf.

artworks.title: August Delatre
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a half-length portrait of a man in a three-quarter view, facing slightly towards the left. He is seated in a slightly turned position. The man's facial features, including a prominent brow, deep-set eyes, a mustache, and a full beard, are prominently depicted. His hair is full and wavy, swept back. He is wearing a high-collared shirt or jacket with the collar standing up against his neck. The etching's lines and cross-hatching create depth and texture. In the background, there are additional lines and text inscribed in the top right corner that reads "Homage à MR Delâtre F. Whistler." The background is plain, emphasizing the detailed rendering of the man's face and garments.

artworks.title: The Wine-Glass
artworks.medium: etching in dark brown on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a glass cup with a long stem placed on a surface. The artwork is in a monochrome palette of brown and off-white, focusing on detailed line work. The glass is centrally positioned above a textured cloth, with a background of densely hatched lines to create a three-dimensional effect.
